item.title: World Cancer Day: How Pauline Wilkinson found hope through PNE Versus Cancer

item.title: EFL statement: Swindon Town Football Club
item.description: An Independent Disciplinary Commission has determined that Swindon Town Football Club is to be removed from this season’s Vertu Trophy competition for breaches of EFL Regulations and EFL Trophy Rules.
